---
name: Feature proposal
about: Pitch a new MPAL capability (instrument, visualization, workflow, etc.).
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem / opportunity
Who benefits from this change (clinicians, researchers, demo audiences) and what friction are they facing?

## Proposed solution
Outline the user experience. Include CLI flags, UI mockups, or YAML examples if possible.

## Definition of done
- [ ] User story + acceptance criteria captured
- [ ] Tests cover the new behavior
- [ ] Docs (`README`, `docs/`, screenshots) updated

## Dependencies / blockers
List related issues, instrument specs, or design work needed first.

## Additional notes
Link to references, papers, or feature inspiration.
